from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def ik(p,side='left',orientation=None,seed=None):
 ids=[11,12,13,14,15,16,17] if side=='left' else [40,41,42,43,44,45,46]
 aid=[11,12,13,14,15,21,22] if side=='left' else [16,17,18,19,20,41,42]
 lim=np.array(s['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad'])[aid]
 q=np.zeros(69)
 def cost(v):
  q[ids]=v;T=transform(q,anc[ids[-1]])
  err=list((hand(q,side)-p)*8)
  if orientation is not None:err.extend((T[:3,:3]-orientation).ravel()*.8)
  err.extend(v*.03)
  return err
 seeds=[seed] if seed is not None else [np.zeros(7),[-.4,.2,0,-.4,1.2,0,0],[-1,.4,0,.6,1.2,0,0]]
 best=None
 for seed in seeds:
  res=least_squares(cost,np.clip(seed,lim[:,0]+.001,lim[:,1]-.001),bounds=(lim[:,0]+.001,lim[:,1]-.001))
  if best is None or np.linalg.norm(res.fun)<np.linalg.norm(best.fun):best=res
 q[ids]=best.x

"""Standard client cabinet controller. Commands and targets are saved before execution.
Replay: python gen.py replay (on a new externally supplied episode only).
Drive: python gen.py move LABEL STEPS '{joint_name: radians, ...}'
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output');r=Robot();spec=r.spec()
layout=spec['action_types']['joint_position']['layout'];ranges=np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad'])
pl=spec['proprio_layout'];joints=spec['proprio']['joints']
def measured_action(meta):
    q=dict(zip(pl,meta['proprio']['now']));a=[]
    for name in layout:
        n=name.replace('_A_','_')
        val=q[n+'_pos'] if not n.endswith('J0') else q[n[:-1]+'1_pos']+q[n[:-1]+'2_pos']
        a.append(val)
    return np.clip(2*(np.array(a)-ranges[:,0])/(ranges[:,1]-ranges[:,0])-1,-1,1)
def save(res,label):
    res.save(str(OUT/label));(OUT/'latest.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta));
    print(json.dumps({k:res.meta.get(k) for k in ['control_steps','done','reason','clipped']}))
    q=dict(zip(pl,res.meta['proprio']['now']));print({k:round(v,3) for k,v in q.items() if k.startswith('imu_')})
def move(label,steps,changes,balance=False):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['room_camera'],video='none');start=measured_action(obs.meta) if not (OUT/'target.npy').exists() else np.load(OUT/'target.npy')
    target=start.copy()
    for n,v in changes.items():
        i=layout.index(n);target[i]=np.clip(2*(v-ranges[i,0])/(ranges[i,1]-ranges[i,0])-1,-1,1)
    A=np.linspace(start,target,steps+1)[1:];np.save(OUT/(label+'_actions.npy'),A)
    with (OUT/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'label':label,'steps':steps,'changes':changes,'actions':label+'_actions.npy'})+'\n')
    res=r.submit('joint_position',A,cameras=None,video='frames',video_fps=25,note=label);np.save(OUT/'target.npy',target);save(res,label)
    return res
if __name__=='__main__':
    if len(sys.argv)==1:save(r.get_obs(video='none'),'initial')
    elif sys.argv[1]=='move':move(sys.argv[2],int(sys.argv[3]),json.loads(sys.argv[4]))
    elif sys.argv[1]=='obs':save(r.get_obs(video='none'),sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'view')
    elif sys.argv[1]=='replay':
        for line in (OUT/'commands.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
            c=json.loads(line);res=r.submit('joint_position',np.load(OUT/c['actions']),cameras=['room_camera'],video='none',note=c['label'])
            if res.done:break
        print(r.status())
PY
